title: CI clippy failures are unreadable by agents: the quality job's diagnostics must reach the job summary or an artifact, since run logs need admin rights
outcome: CI clippy failures are unreadable by agents: the quality job's diagnostics must reach the job summary or an artifact, since run logs need admin rights
acceptance: A landed commit whose Linux clippy fails is classified from that output within one message, verified on the next such failure or on a deliberate probe branch, and the item's note records the run

The quality job in .github/workflows/ci.yml writes clippy's diagnostics (and fmt's, if it fails) into the GitHub job summary and uploads them as a run artifact, so an agent with the repository token reads the failure without run-log access
